messages:
incident-bot:  P1 ALERT: Sustained error surge and throttled connections on /v1/chat and isolated spikes on /v1/embeddings detected at 02:11 UTC. 5xx chat=8.9% (baseline 0.3%), embeddings p99 +600ms. Auto-page oncall. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/1793459999

Nora: Ack. Marta, you're on. Diego, please jump in for infra.

Diego: Looking at GPU host metrics now. Pattern: bursty large-context requests hitting llama-70b-qat causing KV cache thrash and OOM kill-retries. Embeddings nodes showing IO congestion tied to background snapshot.

Marta (oncall): Immediate mitigation steps we should take: 1) Apply per-route plan-aware qps caps; 2) Enforce hard token cap at edge for hosted (reject > 16k tokens); 3) Temporarily lower batch size for llama-70b-qat; 4) Suspend non-critical background snapshots for 10 minutes. We'll also issue customer notices.

Lin: Also suggest per-tenant dynamic backpressure: if tenant's error share >2% in 10m, auto-cut to trial/free limits.

Marta (oncall): Applying changes now. Posting exact commands for audit and reproducibility:

```
# route quota: plan-aware caps
curl -s -X PUT https://admin.internal/redwood/quotas/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"global_qps":220,"plan_caps":{"enterprise":800,"paid":250,"trial":15,"free":8}}'

# hard token reject at edge
curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal/redwood/edge/config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","max_tokens":16000,"reject_code":413,"reject_message":"Context too large - reduce prompt or chunk"}'

# reduce batch size for problematic model
curl -s -X PATCH https://admin.internal/redwood/models/llama-70b-qat -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"max_batch":4,"preferred_batch":2,"kv_cache_eviction":"aggressive"}'

# pause background snapshot jobs for 10m
curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal/redwood/ops/jobs/pause -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"job":"snapshot","duration_minutes":10}'
```

incident-bot: Commands accepted. change_ids: qcap_1793459, edge_1793460, model_1793461, job_1793462. Rolling out to nodes.

Diego: Observability: within 90s, host memory pressure decreases and OOM retry count drops. chat 5xx down to 2.0% after 3m.

Support-bot: Running customer impact query to identify tenants with >1% errors:

```
SELECT tenant_name, route, error_percent FROM telemetry.errors WHERE window='12m' AND error_percent>0.01;
-- results: SyntaxPro (4.6% on /v1/chat), Tutorly (2.4% chat), DataForge (1.2% embeddings)
```

Nora: Support: send proactive notifications to SyntaxPro and Tutorly. Mark DataForge as monitoring only. Include mitigation steps and ETA for relaxing quotas.

Support-bot: Tickets opened: #SUP-6720 SyntaxPro, #SUP-6721 Tutorly. Draft posted to status page.

Lin: I pushed a short noisy-neighbor detection rule into the runtime to auto-escalate per-tenant caps when they exceed 5x median qps for 5m. It will start firing if we see recurrence.

Marta (oncall): Good. Also enabled a temporary plan override: raised SyntaxPro to 180 qpm for 20 minutes because they have paid burst credits. Applied.

Diego: Snapshot pause confirmed; IO noise subsiding. embeddings p99 down ~300ms.

Nora: Any customer on dedicated capacity affected? Check tags.

Diego: Quick check: SyntaxPro is hosted, Tutorly is hosted; no dedicated tenants flagged. Dedicated infra unaffected.

Marta (oncall): Monitoring: chat 5xx now ~0.5% over last 5m. Latency improved p95 by ~280ms. Keeping the hard token reject and plan caps for 40 minutes. Will gradually relax plan caps if stable.

Lin: Added follow-up item for runtime: add per-route token soft-block with informative headers (Retry-After + suggested chunking snippet) instead of immediate drop where possible.

Nora: Post-incident actions: owner Diego. Actions: 1) autoscaler tweak to factor median sequence length and tail percentiles; 2) model config defaults that favor smaller preferred_batch for quantized 70b variants; 3) admin UI guardrail to preview tenant impact when editing plan caps; 4) implement early tokenizer-based rejections at edge.

Marta (oncall): Handoff: I'll remain for 15m then hand to Lin for watch. Please add me and Diego to the postmortem doc.

Ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded P1->P2 at 02:45 UTC. Active mitigations remain; monitoring alpha.

Support-bot: Status page updated: "Partial disruption to hosted chat for a subset of customers; mitigations applied. Support tickets opened for affected customers."

Nora: Thanks team. Diego, include per-tenant timeline and the SQL queries used in the postmortem. Lin, create a follow-up ticket for runtime-side soft-block with headers.

Diego: Will do. Drafting postmortem now and will own RCA. ETA EOD.

Marta (oncall): Closing handoff. If regression, reopen and page @pager-duty. :raised_hands:
